reviewer: Codex primary AI source and visual inspection, 22 September 2026
findings: All seven fine review images were inspected: installed isometric, mechanism, exposed races/balls, cage, full section, enlarged contact section and full SNL comparison.

Full SNL Plate21 and pages8,164,165 establish thirty quarter-inch balls, separate SH998C retainer and SH998A stop ring. Page157 supplies six spring plungers; original HB115 supplies the conditional diameter transfer for their future holes.

The native axial section follows the separate thrust collar, opposing stop-ring member and ball retainer arrangement. Source orientation is retained opposite the native view, and independent panel scales do not establish dimensions.

The enlarged native section shows both axial reaction surfaces, ball contact, surrounding clearance and cage material on either side of the pocket. These are actual saved BRep cuts, not invented diagram geometry.

The exposed retainer view shows distinct spheres on the circle and a separate perforated cage. The finer 0.04 mm display mesh removes the coarse octagonal appearance while keeping the analytic native solids unchanged.
The installed view retains transmission input, pump, belt and earlier clutch components. The stop ring is seated on the balls; its six holes await the real spring-plunger set and supported mounting.
remaining_discrepancies: Race pitch circle, groove section/depth, cage section and manufacturing method, angular phase and ring contour remain estimates.
The source stop-ring rim, plunger ends and adjacent cone structure are not fully represented yet. Six hole positions are provisional receiving geometry.
The thin cage holds a static pattern without a modeled cage-forming or ball insertion sequence. Preload, loads, wear and historical fit are not established.
HB and SNL part marks differ; no new universal identity mapping is asserted. Cones, springs, engine interfaces and standard tank integration remain unfinished.
